resources.string: Use the desktop wallpaper with AOSP blur in the area around the one-handed screen.
Swipe up to go Home or open Recents while keeping one-handed mode active. Turn off to swipe up to exit one-handed mode.
Swipe down from the bottom gesture area. Start on the left or right to choose that side.
Swipe inward from the screen edge beside the blank area to switch sides.
Swipe up in the left or right blank strip to enlarge, or down to shrink. Release to remember the size.
Tap the space, go full screen
Tap the blank area outside the smaller screen to exit.
Turn on “Blurred wallpaper background” to fill the blank area with your blurred wallpaper.
Checking system support and Xposed activation
Enable the module in LSPosed, select System Framework and SystemUI, then restart your device. AOSP systems using a launcher taskbar also need the launcher selected.

With gesture navigation enabled, swipe down from the bottom gesture bar while your device is unlocked and in portrait orientation. On Xiaomi devices, you can also swipe down from the bottom gesture area when the gesture bar is hidden.\n\nSwipe down on the left half to anchor the screen at the bottom left, or on the right half to anchor it at the bottom right.

Tap the blank area outside the scaled screen to exit. By default, swiping up from the bottom gesture bar also exits one-handed mode.

Enable “Keep Home and Recents gestures” to swipe up to go Home or open Recents while keeping one-handed mode active. Use the blank area to exit.

Tap the settings button in the blank area to open this app. Rotating the screen or turning it off also exits one-handed mode.

The scale is the width and height of the smaller screen as a percentage of the original. At 70%, both dimensions are 70% of their original size. The content, gesture bar, and corner radius scale proportionally.

The presets are 80%, 70%, and 60%. Choose Custom to adjust from 20% to 90%. Changes apply immediately while one-handed mode is active.

Swipe up in the blank area to enlarge the screen, or down to shrink it. Releasing saves the size to Custom for the next session. Swipe left in the right blank strip to move a left-anchored screen to the right; swipe right in the left blank strip to move it to the left.

After enabling the module and restarting, another app can send a broadcast with action io.githuh.onehandedmode.action.START to package com.android.systemui. The sender needs no root or system permission.

Shell command:
am broadcast -a io.githuh.onehandedmode.action.START -p com.android.systemui

The screen opens on the right by default. Add --es side left to open on the left, or --es side right for the right. The current scale applies. Repeated requests keep an active mode open. Entry requires an unlocked device in portrait orientation, as with gestures.
